installs: Twenty-two skill directories under codex-skills/, each holding one SKILL.md (investment-memo-craft also ships an agents/openai.yaml subagent definition), installed by scripts/install-codex-skills.sh into the Codex skills directory; 21 prompt documents under codex-prompts/ installed by scripts/install-codex-prompts.sh; 21 command documents under skills/ installed by scripts/install-claude-commands.sh into the Claude commands directory. The README documents Claude Code and Codex installs. The reports/, output/, data/, docs/, and assets/ trees are published research outputs and fixtures the installers do not copy into a host.
distribution_machinery: scripts/install-codex-skills.sh, scripts/install-codex-prompts.sh, scripts/install-claude-commands.sh and their .bat counterparts with scripts/sync-codex-skills.py and scripts/sync-codex-prompts.py, which copy the pack's own documents into host directories.
not_a_system: Owns no durable state it reads back and does no enforced work in ADR 031's terms. The tools/*.py programs (financial verification, market-data fetchers, backtesters, scrapers) run discrete computations when the host invokes them at a skill's instruction; they deny nothing, rewrite nothing, persist nothing the skill reads back, and execute nothing by themselves. tools/log-command.sh is a prompt-logging helper with no hook configuration in the tree, installed by no installer, and read back by nothing, and the published reports and return figures are the author's own outputs and claims, not reliability evidence.
